title: BottomNavTab holds a string-resource id instead of a raw label
name: BottomNavTab
description: The nav-tab label needs to be a string resource so it can be localized, but the list that constructs these (bottomNavTabs) is a plain top-level val, not inside a @Composable -- so it must hold a resource id (resolved later, at render time inside the Composable), not a resolved String.
acceptance_criteria: route and icon fields are unchanged
exact_code: private data class BottomNavTab(val route: String, val labelRes: Int, val icon: ImageVector)
